projects.title: Travel Frog: A Journey to China — Local Reverse-Engineered Edition
projects.description: An unofficial local recreation of the game's full feature set, with Standard and Gallery editions for Windows, Android, and the web.
projects.details: Recreates travel, postcards, albums and animated photos, shops and lottery, visitors, gardening, furniture, crafting, collections, and seasonal events. Saves can be imported, exported, and transferred between devices. Testing is ongoing; downloads and online play are not yet available. The project page includes installation and official-save backup instructions.
highlights: Travel, postcards, albums, and full collections
Gardening, furniture, crafting, and seasonal events
Standard & Gallery editions with separate saves
Save import, export, and device migration
